line.text: status: approved   # by the operator, 2026-11-18, in a session: "4: yes stabilize", in answer to the item "three timing-sensitive tests keep reddening PRs; stabilize them in a small spec of their own". The text below was written after that answer, from the code and the CI logs; the operator has not read it. It names two more tests than the three the operator was told about (section 3, T4 and the listed L1 to L3); T4 is built only because its cause is shown from code, and the operator may strike it. It takes effect when the operator merges the pull request that carries it.

summary.text: Tests that fail on a pull request they have nothing to do with, and pass on a rerun, cost a macOS job each time and teach people to rerun instead of read. Over 2026-11-16 to 2026-11-18 tests of this kind reddened pull requests or `main` again and again. This spec fixes the four whose cause is shown (T1 to T4), and lists the rest (L1 to L3).
